free_tier.stated: 10 GiB per workspace, stated verbatim: 'Each workspace can store up to 10 GiB in total. When the workspace is full, uploads return a 403 error.'

retention.stated: Keep your own copy of every file you upload.' Only model-created/promoted files are downloadable. Retention: indefinite.

egress.terms: Files API has 'no separate charge' and files 'do not expire' — but read-gated by design.

tooling: POST /api/v1/files (multipart), GET /api/v1/files, GET /api/v1/files/{id}/content. Global endpoint only (eu./us. return 403).
chaining: 10 GiB x unlimited workspaces is arithmetically a chain, but uploaded bytes cannot be downloaded again, so it is a write-only sink, not storage.
limits_note: per-object-cap 100 MiB ('A larger file returns a 413 error'); 10 GiB per workspace; content-type sniffed from bytes and restricted to PDF/PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/MP3/WAV/FLAC/OGG/UTF-8 text — arbitrary binaries are rejected at upload. **Upload-open / read-gated**: 'A request to GET /api/v1/files/{file_id}/content for an uploaded file returns a 400 error. Keep your own copy of every file you upload.' Only model-created/promoted files are downloadable. Retention: indefinite.
reliability_note: Beta; in-region endpoints return 403. Downloaded files must be created by a sandbox/model, not uploaded by you.

evidence.proved: 'The maximum file size is 100 MiB ... 413'; 'Each workspace can store up to 10 GiB in total'; 'Files that you upload cannot be downloaded directly'
'Maximum file size: 100 MB; empty files are rejected ... must be a PDF, a PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image, a DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, an MP3/WAV/FLAC/OGG, or UTF-8 text'
